question:
Select the option that represents the letters which, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

A _ _ D F _ K _ _ F A _ L _ _
options:
K L A L D K D F

L A L K D F D K

D L K L F A L D

F D L A K F D L
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. K L A L D K D F.

Given: A _ _ D F _ K _ _ F A _ L _ _

Option 1: K L A L D K D F

A K L D F /A K L D F / A K L D F

Thus, pattern of A K L D F is followed.

options_hi:
K L A L D K D F

L A L K D F D K

D L K L F A L D

F D L A K F D L
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 अर्थात् K L A L D K D F है।

Given: A _ _ D F _ K _ _ F A _ L _ _
